objective: first win at or before horizon inputs
state_encoding: 105-bit masks for walls, crates, each hero and notes; booleans for active hero and door
hero_loss_pruned: Druid petrifying Bard and closing door on either hero are losing because both heroes are necessary for the two goals
bard_movement: prior note aura; fixed point allows each blocked charmed object to remain independently; blocked Bard cancels the turn
door_behavior: opens when all switches are weighed; closing can remove walls and crates or kill heroes
noops: permitted where the game permits them

redundant_global_landmarks.all_material_switches: some full-history frame has all nine switches occupied by walls or crates
redundant_global_landmarks.wall_to_crate_events: at least nine Druid wall-to-crate events occur before victory
redundant_global_landmarks.proof: Before both heroes first enter the three-cell goal enclosure, a hero occupies a door while neither is on a switch; therefore nine material tokens weigh the switches. Each began as a boundary wall and must have been converted to a crate to reach a switch. A door closure can delete, but not create, material. See structure_system.md.
redundant_global_landmarks.guard: exact original grid and catalog source hash checked before enabling

solver_result_semantics.unsat: no modeled win at or before horizon, subject to model correctness

calibration_limits: sampled oracle agreement is evidence, not a proof of model equivalence
